summary: An accessor (getter) method returns a private field's value, and a mutator (setter) method changes it. A mutator can check a new value before it saves it.
notes: private double gpa; means code in Main cannot read or change gpa directly.
setGpa only saves newGpa when it is between 0.0 and 4.0.
Getters return the field's type. Mutators like setGpa and promote are void.
pitfall: Writing maya.gpa in Main causes the compile error: gpa has private access in Student. Use maya.getGpa() instead.
